capability.detail: Windows shares C:\VeilShared as VeilShared; macOS mounts it over a loopback port forward.

hostMount.detail: /Volumes/VeilShared is not present, so the share is not mounted on this Mac.

nextActions: The Windows guest agent did not answer, so Veil cannot confirm the share exists.
Run veil-vmctl guest-agent-wait --json, then veil-vmctl app-runtime-action --json --action repair-agent if it stays unreachable.
An agent that predates the shared folder protocol also reports as unreachable here; reinstall it with veil-vmctl qemu-install-agent --json.
